ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The outer two-thirds of both lobes are dominated by contiguous high-intensity white pixels. The central region, extending from the peduncle attachment to the notch, consists of a dense, low-intensity black mass forming an inverted-triangle or 'V' shape. Thin low-intensity bands define the leading edges and the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding box depth roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge. Notable peaks (spires) are located at the extreme distal tips and smaller, clustered valleys are distributed evenly toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal tips (forming an 'S' shape on the upper boundary).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters on the extreme distal tips and along the right-hand trailing edge, consistent with acorn barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal high-contrast linear marks (forming a rough 'X' pattern) are located in the low-intensity black region of the left lobe. One dark vertical linear mark is visible on the far-left high-intensity lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible criss-cross scarring (rake marks) on the central-left black pigmentation zone; jagged, irregular tissue loss/serration on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black speckling pattern localized within the high-intensity white region of the lower right lobe.
